stories.headline: New Forests buys Oregon timberland with a carbon project planned
stories.body: New Forests has completed the purchase of 9,300 acres in Josephine County, Oregon. Its November 25 announcement says the property includes Douglas-fir forest and habitat for northern spotted owls and Pacific martens.

stories.headline: Workshop follows wood from harvest plots to export documents
stories.body: BC Wood is accepting registrations for a December 8 online workshop on forest geolocation and supply-chain traceability, from 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Pacific. The listed cost is C$22 per person.

featuredResource.title: Harvesting Woody Biomass: A Small Business Guide
featuredResource.description: This free book helps logging businesses evaluate whether biomass production fits their operations and markets. It covers harvesting systems, financial calculations and business planning, including an example expansion plan.
